value.rationale: Global SUS length measures the shortest occurrence-distinguishing contiguous signature. Its worst case under a natural three-one sparse-source constraint is an exact invariant, not a restatement of algorithmic computability. The n mod 4 sharp law and complete bounded-cardinality family of extremizers reveal rigidity of worst-case sparse signatures; a short direct proof validates why equal interior spacing is forced.
